interpretation.highRefreshSubmissionReady: True only when p95 submission work is at or below 4.17 ms in this run.
interpretation.guarantee: No universal FPS guarantee is made. Hardware, display refresh, browser scheduling, driver and scene all matter.

metrics.actualFpsBoundary: Displayed FPS is bounded by the monitor, browser scheduler, GPU, scene and device.
